description: Complete frontend UI: landing/create page, host dashboard (request queue with audio alerts, menu management with fridge scan + review flow, location/QR management), and guest interface (request submission with live status tracker). All real-time updates via SSE. Mobile-first responsive design. All errors shown in UI.
steps: Create src/app/page.tsx - Landing page with 'Create a Party' form. Single input for party name (optional, placeholder shows default). Submit button creates party via POST /api/parties, then redirects to host dashboard. Show loading state during creation. Show error in UI if creation fails.

Create src/app/host/[hostCode]/page.tsx - Host dashboard layout. Tabs or sections for: Requests (default view), Menu, Locations/QR. Fetches party data on load via GET /api/parties/[hostCode]. Shows party name, guest link (copyable), and time remaining. 404 page if party not found/expired.

Create src/components/host/RequestQueue.tsx - Shows all requests newest-first. Each request card shows: category icon/label, item name, note (if any), delivery info (location name or guest name), timestamp (relative like '2m ago'). New requests highlighted with animation. Seen requests slightly muted. Done requests grouped at bottom, visually de-emphasized. Single-tap buttons: 'Mark Seen' (new->seen), 'Mark Done' (seen->done or new->done). Show error toast if status update fails.

Create src/components/host/AudioAlert.tsx - Audio alert system for new requests. On mount, show a prominent 'Enable Sound Alerts' button (required for browser audio policy). Once clicked, play a short notification sound on each 'new-request' SSE event. Use Web Audio API to generate a pleasant chime programmatically (no audio file needed). Show visual indicator that sound is enabled/disabled.

Create src/components/host/MenuManager.tsx - Two sections: Drinks and Supplies. Each item shows name, availability toggle (switch), edit (inline rename), delete button. 'Add Drink' form at top with text input. Availability toggle sends PATCH immediately and updates UI optimistically. Show error and revert if toggle fails. Supply items show same controls.

Create src/components/host/FridgeScan.tsx - Fridge scan flow: (1) Upload area accepting 1-5 photos (drag-drop or file picker, images only). (2) 'Scan Photos' button submits to scan endpoint, shows loading spinner. (3) On success: shows ReviewDraftModal. (4) On error: shows the error message prominently with 'Add drinks manually instead' link/button. Never crashes, never shows technical errors.

Create src/components/host/ReviewDraftModal.tsx - Modal showing AI-detected drink names as editable list. Each item has: text input (pre-filled with detected name, editable), delete button. 'Add another' button at bottom. Two actions: 'Publish to Menu' (adds all items as drinks) and 'Cancel'. Publish sends individual POST requests to menu endpoint for each drink. Shows success count or errors.

Create src/components/host/LocationManager.tsx - List of created locations, each showing: name, QR code preview (small), copy link button, print button. 'Add Location' form with name input. Print button opens print-friendly view of QR code with location label and tagline 'Need something? Scan me.'

Create src/components/host/QRPrintView.tsx - Print-optimized component for a single QR code. Large QR code, location name as heading, 'Need something? Scan me.' as subheading. Uses @media print CSS for clean printing. Triggered by window.print() on the print-view route.

Create src/app/party/[guestCode]/page.tsx - Guest entry page. If URL has ?loc=CODE query param, resolve location name. Show party name, headline 'Need something?'. Four request categories as large tap targets: a drink (shows drink menu), a supply (shows supply list), a song (shows text input), something else (shows text input). Mobile-optimized, large touch targets, minimal text.

Create src/components/guest/DrinkRequest.tsx - Shows available drinks as a list of large buttons. On tap, shows delivery target selection: if location is known from URL, show 'Bring it here (Location Name)' as primary option. Always show 'Find me' option with name input. Optional note field. Submit button. Show confirmation or error.
Create src/components/guest/SupplyRequest.tsx - Shows supply items as large single-tap buttons. One tap = submitted. Show brief confirmation animation/toast. No additional input needed.
Create src/components/guest/SongRequest.tsx - Text input for song name/artist. Submit button. Show confirmation or error. Single field, single tap to submit.
Create src/components/guest/OtherRequest.tsx - Text input for free-text request. Submit button. Show confirmation or error.

Create src/components/guest/RequestTracker.tsx - After submission, shows live status tracker: three steps 'Sent / Seen / Done' as a horizontal progress indicator. Current step highlighted/animated. 'Seen' step is visually prominent (larger, different color) as the core promise. Subscribes to SSE for real-time updates. Also polls on page visibility change (for returning guests per R7.4). Shows the item name and any note as context.
Create src/hooks/useSSE.ts - Custom React hook for SSE connections. Accepts party code and event types to listen for. Returns event data. Handles reconnection on disconnect. Cleans up on unmount.
Create src/hooks/useAudioAlert.ts - Custom hook managing Web Audio API. Provides: isEnabled, enable(), playAlert(). Generates a pleasant two-tone chime using OscillatorNode.
Create src/components/ui/ErrorMessage.tsx - Reusable error display component. Shows error text in a red/orange box with clear language. Used throughout for all user-facing errors.
Create src/components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx - Reusable loading indicator.
Create src/components/ui/Toast.tsx - Brief notification component for confirmations and non-blocking messages. Auto-dismisses after 3 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Landing page creates a party and redirects to host dashboard
Host dashboard loads party data and shows requests, menu, and location management
Request queue updates in real-time via SSE when new requests arrive
Audio alert button enables browser audio and chime plays on new request
Menu manager allows adding, renaming, toggling availability, and deleting items
Fridge scan flow handles success (shows review modal) and failure (shows friendly error with manual fallback)
Review modal allows editing detected drinks before publishing to menu
Location manager creates locations with QR codes and provides printable view
Guest interface shows available drinks/supplies and allows one-tap requests
Drink requests require delivery target; location pre-filled if arrived via tagged link
Request tracker shows live Sent/Seen/Done progression via SSE
All errors display in the UI with plain language messages
The entire app builds successfully with npm run build
verification: Run npm run build to verify all pages and components compile without TypeScript errors
Run npm test if tests exist for components
